analyst.summary: 3M India is a high-quality, debt-free MNC-parented industrial/healthcare compounder (30% ROE, 50% ROCE) with FY26 revenue growth of 14%, but reported profit growth of only 9.7% and a 3-year profit CAGR of just 9% - both well short of what its 72-76x trailing (about 49x forward) earnings multiple implies. The headline Q4 FY26 '+202% PAT' figure is a base-effect artifact off a weak prior-year quarter; normalized (ex-exceptional) profit growth that quarter was closer to 10.5%. Two of the last three quarters carried one-off labour-code-transition charges, muddying underlying earnings trends. Q1 FY27 results are due 14-Aug-2026.
